verdict.rationale: Linear's own docs say customer feedback can be analyzed in bulk with Linear Agent, its built-in AI assistant. Customer requests also carry revenue and tier attributes that can be filtered to find high-impact work. However, nothing shows the agent answering conversational questions about feedback themes tied to revenue impact; the revenue analysis is documented only as manual filtering. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the AI assistant answers questions about feedback themes, documented AI reasoning over revenue impact, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an AI assistant questions about customer feedback themes and their revenue impact

citations.quote: analyze feedback in bulk with Linear Agent
View and filter issues or projects by customer name, count, status, tier revenue, and size to identify high impact customer work
Customer attributes such as size and revenue can be synced with and managed from Intercom.
